HOW TO PLAY

Every night the boss picks a house. Sneak in, grab the valuables and get them to the van before anyone notices. Every bump costs money and every noise can wake the homeowner.

Phone: left thumb moves. Push the stick only a little to sneak, which is silent. SHOVE pushes people, loot, homeowners and dogs. SPRINT is fast but loud. GRAB picks up loot and coworkers.
Keyboard + mouse: WASD move, mouse looks around (click the game first), B drip cam (see yourself), Left click shove (hold with loot to charge a throw), E or Right click grab / open doors / hide / drive the cart, Shift sprint, C sneak toggle, F flashlight, Q ping, Tab map, Enter leave, Esc pause. All keys can be rebound in Settings.
Lockpicking: hold GRAB at a locked door and let go when the needle is in the green. Miss and it clanks.
Floors: carpet is quiet, wood is normal, tile is loud.
Keyboard P2: arrows, Right Shift sneak, . shove, , grab, / sprint, ; ping, ' light.
Cart: grab it from behind to drive, steer with the stick or keys. Fast turns topple the pile. Grab from the side to take loot out.
Heavy loot: clocks and safes need two people. One person can only drag them, loudly.
Controller: left stick move, right stick aim, X/RT shove, A/LT sprint, B grab, Y ping, LB sneak, RB light, Select map.
Loot loses value every time it hits something, and every bump is noise. Stack it in the cart and roll it to the van.
Homeowners sleep until noise wakes them. If one sees you they call the cops, so shove them to stop the call. Dogs sniff out loners and can't open doors; treats calm them. Cameras trip the alarm if they watch you too long, so cut the power at the fuse box. Once the alarm goes off, the cops are on their way. Get to the van.
Jobs: hit the boss's target to get your cut, then buy gear from the fence, gamble, and spin the prize wheel. Miss the target and you're out of the crew.
